name: chat_gateway
summary: The chat gateway. Every cc chat call flows through here. Orchestrates: prev_forward read → user_graph predict → MoE retrieve → enhance → assemble master chain → route → slice → downward dispatch → forward project → log to crystal chain → record to user_graph.
engine_pattern: stateless orchestrator. Each cmd_* function executes the same deterministic pipeline. State lives in the substrates; chat.py is the wire.

subcommands.enhance: spell-fix + structural enhancement only (no model call, no chain)
subcommands.chain: assemble + render the master workspace-coordinate chain
subcommands.full: the whole pipeline — prev_forward + user_predict + moe_retrieve + enhance + assemble + route + slice + project + log + record
subcommands.downward: slice for a lower tier from a higher tier's perspective
subcommands.godot: emit cc_godot_bridge_v1 JSON packet for Godot CCBridge autoload

pipeline_v1: 0a. _read_prev_forward() — pulls last non-placeholder forward chain from crystal chain tail
0c. _moe_find_experts(prompt, k=5) — content match across all past records
1.  enhancer.enhance(prompt, scope_hint=cwd) — spell-fix + inject SCOPE/INTENT/CONSTRAINTS/OUTPUT (OUTPUT marker tells controlled models to emit <forward>...</forward> tail)
1b. Prepend PRIOR EXPERT FORWARD CHAINS block (if any), then prepend PRIOR FORWARD CHAIN (if present)
4.  slicer.slice_by_tier(root, tier) — chain slices for the routed tier
5.  (if tier in large|epic) slicer.downward_slice() — generate scoped slices for medium + tiny
6.  project_forward(reasoning_trace, output_text, prev_forward, enable_posthoc=CC_FORWARD_POSTHOC) — inline extract + posthoc fallback
substrate: none (gateway only — touches every substrate via the helpers)

env_vars.CC_SCOPE_CWD: scope hint injected into the enhanced prompt's SCOPE marker
env_vars.CC_FORWARD_POSTHOC: set to 1 to enable tiny-model posthoc projection (default off)
env_vars.CC_TIMESTAMP: timestamp injected into Godot bridge packets

outbound_calls: core/lib/model_registry.py::ModelRegistry (transitive via token_router — tier → canonical model name)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: all three (crystal chain via _read_prev_forward + _moe_find_experts, user_graph via _user_graph_predict)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: all three (crystal chain via _log_inference, user_graph via _user_graph_record, semantic_index via SemanticIndex.index_record)

v1_extension_2026_05_28: Added MoE retrieval, forward projection, user_graph predict/record, prior chain injection. Output JSON now carries crystal_id + user_graph_turn_uuid + moe_experts + user_graph_prediction + forward_chain.
usage_example: python3 core/lib/chat.py full 'wire the moe router into the godot bridge'\n# Returns JSON with all 16 top-level fields. crystal_id is the primary key into the chain; turn_uuid the key into user_graph.
